title: Reducing Technician Search Burden: A Multimodal RAG for Cessna 172 Maintenance Manual
abstract: arXiv:2608.18465v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Proper use of the aircraft maintenance manual is essential for correct maintenance, providing procedures, diagrams, cautions, and specifications. However, technicians often avoid consulting it because it is difficult to navigate and time-consuming under strict schedules. Retrieval augmented generation (RAG) models have recently been introduced in aircraft maintenance, yet existing models focus solely on textual retrieval. This research therefore targeted the Cessna 172 Maintenance Manual (C172-MM), widely used in general aviation, and developed a multimodal manual retriever (MMR) capable of retrieving multimodal manual pages. Retrieval performance was evaluated using synthetic queries covering procedures, diagrams, caution/safety information, and specifications; the MMR achieved 93.37% recall@5. translated_title: 减轻技师检索负担：针对塞斯纳172维修手册的多模态RAG系统
translated_abstract: 正确使用飞机维修手册对于确保维修工作无误至关重要，它提供了程序、图解、注意事项和规格参数。然而，技师常常因为手册难以导航且在严格时间限制下耗时过长而避免查阅。近年来，检索增强生成（RAG）模型被引入飞机维修领域，但现有模型仅侧重于文本检索。因此，本研究以通用航空中广泛使用的塞斯纳172维修手册（C172-MM）为目标，开发了一种能够检索多模态手册页面的多模态手册检索器（MMR）。检索性能通过涵盖程序、图解、警告/安全信息和规格参数的综合查询进行评估；MMR实现了93.37%的召回率@5。在检索之外，还研究了一种多模态RAG（MRAG）流程，其中检索到的页面被输入视觉语言模型，由其生成...
tldr: 本研究开发了一种针对塞斯纳172维修手册的多模态检索增强生成系统，通过同时检索文本和图像页面，显著减少了技师查找维修信息的时间负担，达到了93.37%的召回率。
en_tdlr: This research developed a multimodal retrieval-augmented generation system for the Cessna 172 maintenance manual, reducing technicians' search burden by retrieving both text and image pages, achieving 93.37% recall@5.
